title: Olleik Foods: customer guide
pronunciation: "Olleik" is written "Oh-lake" in the spoken text only (the voice reads the plain spelling as "Olik"); on screen it stays "Olleik"

lines.text: Welcome to Olleik Foods. This guide shows you how to open an account and place your first order.
lines.speak: Welcome to Oh-lake Foods. This guide shows you how to open an account and place your first order.
lines.caption: Welcome to the Olleik Foods customer guide

lines.text: To open a wholesale account, choose Become a customer on the Olleik Foods website.
lines.speak: To open a wholesale account, choose Become a customer on the Oh-lake Foods website.
lines.caption: Choose Become a customer on the website

lines.text: Fill in your business name, your contact details and your delivery address.
lines.caption: Fill in your business and contact details

lines.text: Add a short note about your kitchen, then send the application.
lines.caption: Add a note, then send the application

lines.text: The Olleik team reviews your application.
lines.speak: The Oh-lake team reviews your application.
lines.caption: The Olleik team reviews your application

lines.text: Once you're approved, sign in with your email and password.
lines.caption: Once approved, sign in with your email

lines.text: Your portal opens on the dashboard, with your catalog, your offers and your orders.
lines.caption: Your portal: catalog, offers and orders

lines.text: Your catalog shows a photo of every product, with the price set for your account.
lines.caption: Every product with a photo and your price

lines.text: Search by name, or filter by category, to find an item quickly.
lines.caption: Search by name or filter by category

lines.text: Tap Add to put an item in your cart. Add as many as you need.
lines.caption: Tap Add to put items in your cart

lines.text: Open the cart to check the quantities, then choose Checkout.
lines.caption: Check the cart, then choose Checkout

lines.text: Choose delivery or pickup, and add a note for the team if you need to.
lines.caption: Delivery or pickup, plus a note

lines.text: Submit the order. Payment stays on your usual account terms.
lines.caption: Submit: payment stays on your usual terms

lines.text: Your order is received. The team confirms it next.
lines.caption: Received: the team confirms it next

lines.text: Under My orders, each order shows its status: received, confirmed, ready, then completed.
lines.caption: Status: received, confirmed, ready, completed

lines.text: Open an order to see its items, its total and your note.
lines.caption: Open an order: items, total and your note

lines.text: Every order has an invoice. Print it, or save it as a PDF.
lines.caption: Every order has an invoice to print or save

lines.text: Your statement lists the products and the orders for any period you choose.
lines.caption: A statement for any period you choose

lines.text: Offers shows the promotions your Olleik rep has set up for you.
lines.speak: Offers shows the promotions your Oh-lake rep has set up for you.
lines.caption: Offers set up by your Olleik rep

lines.text: Account holds your contacts, your delivery address and your payment terms.
lines.caption: Your contacts, address and payment terms

lines.text: That's everything you need to place and follow your orders.
lines.caption: Everything you need to place and follow orders
